title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Enforcement Guarantee

articles.content_en: For the purpose of these Provisions, "enforcement guarantee" means a guarantee provided to a People's Court by a guarantor in accordance with Article 231 of the Civil Procedure Law to guarantee that the person subject to enforcement performs all or part of the obligations determined by an effective legal document.
An enforcement guarantee may be provided by the person subject to enforcement by means of property guarantee, or by another person by means of property guarantee or suretyship.

Where a person subject to enforcement or another person provides an enforcement guarantee, they shall submit a guarantee letter to the People's Court and deliver a copy of the guarantee letter to the applicant for enforcement.

A guarantee letter shall specify the basic information of the guarantor, the period of suspension of enforcement, the guarantee period, the types and amounts of guaranteed claims, the guarantee scope, the guarantee method, the guarantor's commitment to voluntarily accept direct compulsory enforcement if the person subject to enforcement still fails to perform after the expiration of the period of suspension of enforcement, and other contents.
Where property guarantee is provided, the guarantee letter shall also specify the name, quantity, quality, condition, location, and attribution of ownership or use right of the guaranteed property.

Where a company provides an enforcement guarantee for a person subject to enforcement, it shall submit the company's articles of association and a resolution of the board of directors or the shareholders' meeting or the general meeting of shareholders that comply with the provisions of Article 16 of the Company Law.

Where a person subject to enforcement or another person provides an enforcement guarantee and the applicant for enforcement agrees, the applicant shall issue a written consent to the People's Court, or the enforcement personnel may record the content of such consent in the record and have it signed or sealed by the applicant for enforcement.

Where a person subject to enforcement or another person provides property guarantee, they may go through the formalities for the publicity of security interests such as registration in accordance with the Property Law and the Guarantee Law; if the publicity formalities have been completed, the applicant for enforcement may claim priority of compensation according to law.
Where the applicant for enforcement applies to the People's Court to seal up, distrain, or freeze the guaranteed property, the People's Court shall grant the application, unless otherwise agreed in the guarantee letter.
Where the People's Court decides to suspend enforcement, it may suspend the implementation of all enforcement measures, unless otherwise agreed in the guarantee letter.

Where the content of the guarantee letter is inconsistent with the facts and materially affects the lawful rights and interests of the applicant for enforcement, the People's Court may resume enforcement upon the application of the applicant for enforcement.
The period of suspension of enforcement shall be consistent with the agreement in the guarantee letter, but shall not exceed one year at most.

Where, after the expiration of the period of suspension of enforcement, the person subject to enforcement still fails to perform the obligations, or during the period of suspension of enforcement, the guarantor commits acts such as transferring, concealing, selling, or damaging the guaranteed property, the People's Court may resume enforcement upon the application of the applicant for enforcement and directly rule to enforce the guaranteed property or the property of the surety, but shall not change or add the guarantor as a person subject to enforcement.
The enforcement of the guaranteed property or the property of the surety shall be limited to the portion of the property for which the guarantor shall perform the obligations. If the person subject to enforcement has cash or bank deposits that are convenient for enforcement, such cash or bank deposits shall be enforced first.

The guarantee period shall be calculated from the date on which the period of suspension of enforcement expires.
If the guarantee letter does not record the guarantee period or the record is unclear, the guarantee period shall be one year.

After the expiration of the guarantee period, if the applicant for enforcement applies for enforcement of the guaranteed property or the property of the surety, the People's Court shall not support it. Where another person provides property guarantee, the People's Court may, upon its application, lift the sealing up, distraining, or freezing of the guaranteed property.
After the guarantor assumes the guarantee liability, if it initiates a lawsuit to seek recourse against the person subject to enforcement, the People's Court shall accept the case.

Where a person subject to enforcement applies to change or lift all or part of the enforcement measures and guarantees to perform the obligations determined by the effective legal document, these Provisions shall apply mutatis mutandis.

These Provisions shall come into force on March 1, 2018.
Enforcement guarantees established prior to the coming into force of these Provisions shall not be governed by these Provisions.
If any judicial interpretation published by the Supreme People's Court prior to the coming into force of these Provisions is inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
